This '''unidentified Balnab''' worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Biography==
This bounty hunter was present along with two [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] and two [[Human/Legends|Humans]], also [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were scrolling through a list of the latest [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] when they came across [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and decided to take him, since he was worth the most [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] stepped in, however; and said that this one was for her.<ref name="Revenge" />

==Personality and traits==
This bounty hunter wore [[Clothing/Legends|garments]] including a pale [[Color/Legends|blue]] shirt and [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] over his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]," where he was voiced by [[Tom Kane]], who also voices [[Yoda]] in the animated series. In the episode credits, the character is listed as "[[Balnab (group)|Balnab]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]]."<ref name="Revenge" />
